products.title: ACME Everyday Robot Vacuum with Self-Empty Base
products.description: It maps your home with lidar on its first run and then cleans room by room on the schedule you set. The tangle-free roller and 4000 Pa suction are tuned for pet hair on both hard floors and rugs, and the self-empty base goes about eight weeks between bag changes. Quiet mode keeps it under 58 dB so it can run while you're on calls. Works with the ACME Home app for no-go zones and per-room suction levels.
products.subtitle: Lidar mapping, room-by-room schedules, and a base that empties itself for weeks at a time.

products.title: ACME Rest Weighted Blanket, Queen
products.description: Evenly stitched glass-bead fill with a removable, washable bamboo cover that sleeps cool. Three weights; about a tenth of body weight is the usual pick.

products.title: ACME Select 27" 4K IPS Monitor with USB-C
products.description: A 27-inch 4K IPS panel factory-calibrated to 99% sRGB, with a 90W USB-C port that powers your laptop and carries video over one cable. The stand adjusts for height, tilt, and pivot, and the thin bezels make a clean dual-monitor setup. A built-in KVM switches your keyboard and mouse between two computers, which is handy if you split time between a work laptop and a personal desktop.
products.subtitle: Factory-calibrated 4K panel with single-cable USB-C power and video for laptops.

products.title: ACME Studio Mesh Office Chair
products.description: The chair is built around an adjustable lumbar support that tracks the curve of your lower back, with a synchronized recline that keeps your feet planted as you lean. The mesh back keeps airflow moving through long afternoons, the seat pan slides forward and back to fit longer legs, and the 4D armrests adjust in height, depth, width, and angle so your shoulders can actually relax. Assembly takes about 20 minutes with the included tools.
products.subtitle: Adjustable lumbar, 4D armrests, and a breathable mesh back built for full workdays.

products.title: ACME Studio 48" Electric Standing Desk
products.description: Dual-motor lift with four memory presets and a bamboo top that doesn't wobble at standing height.

products.title: ACME Select Low-Profile Mechanical Keyboard

products.title: ACME Select Noise-Cancelling Headphones

products.title: ACME Select 1080p Webcam with Auto-Framing

products.title: ACME Studio Adjustable Aluminum Laptop Stand

products.title: ACME Select LED Desk Lamp with Wireless Charger

products.title: ACME Basecamp 2-Person Backpacking Tent
products.description: A true two-person backpacking tent that keeps weight at 2.1 kg without giving up livability: two doors, two vestibules, and enough headroom to sit up and play cards through a rainy evening. Color-coded aluminum poles make the first pitch intuitive, the full-coverage rainfly has taped seams, and the mesh body keeps condensation moving on humid nights. Packs down to the size of a loaf of bread.
products.subtitle: A 2.1 kg freestanding three-season tent that pitches in about four minutes.

products.title: ACME Basecamp 4-Person Family Tent

products.title: ACME Basecamp Gravity Water Filter, 3L

products.title: ACME Fit Adjustable Dumbbells, 5-50 lb Pair

They're sized for apartment corners: each tray is about the footprint of a shoebox. Not designed to be dropped from overhead — treat them like the precision tools they are.

products.title: ACME Journey 22" Carry-On Spinner

The polycarbonate shell flexes on impact instead of cracking, the heavy-duty zippers are oversized, and the 360-degree wheels keep rolling smoothly on cobblestones and carpet alike. Inside: a full-length compression panel, a zip-off laundry bag, and a security-checkpoint-friendly combination lock built into the shell. Sized to fit most overhead bins at 22 x 14 x 9 inches.
products.subtitle: A 2.9 kg polycarbonate carry-on that shrugs off baggage handlers and glides on bad pavement.

products.title: ACME Journey 28" Checked Spinner
products.description: Big-trip volume with a 15% expansion gusset and the same crack-resistant shell as the carry-on.

products.title: ACME Journey Compression Packing Cubes, Set of 6
products.description: Double-zip compression that buys you a third more space, plus a shoe bag for the gross stuff.

products.title: ACME Rest Memory Foam Travel Pillow

products.title: ACME Select Universal Travel Adapter with 65W GaN Charging
products.description: One brick for every outlet shape, fast enough to charge a laptop, with a spare fuse included.

products.title: ACME Journey Hanging Toiletry Bag
products.description: Hangs from any towel bar, opens flat, and quarantines the shampoo that will eventually leak.

products.title: ACME Select Item Tracker, 4-Pack
products.description: Drop one in each bag and stop doing the carousel math — a year of battery, replaceable coin cell.

products.title: ACME Kids Under-the-Sea Twin Bedding Set
products.description: The Under-the-Sea set sends bedtime beneath the waves: whales, sea turtles, and schools of fish drift across a teal-and-navy brushed-microfiber comforter, with a matching fitted sheet and one pillowcase. A year of weekly washes in testing left the colors bright.
products.subtitle: Twin comforter, fitted sheet, and pillowcase in a friendly whale, sea-turtle, and starfish print.

products.title: ACME Kids Peel-and-Stick Ocean Wall Decals (36 pc)
products.description: Thirty-six matte decals: a whale, dolphins, sea turtles, seahorses, and drifts of fish, plus coral and bubbles to scatter between them. Each one repositions without lifting paint, so the reef can be rebuilt whenever inspiration strikes.
products.subtitle: 36 removable ocean decals — a two-foot whale down to palm-size seahorses — that peel off clean.

products.title: ACME Kids Tide-Pool Print Area Rug 4x5 ft
products.description: The rug is half decor, half toy: a printed shoreline runs from a lighthouse past tide pools out to a reef, with channels for boats and figures to travel, and the low pile stays flat under bins and play. Non-slip backing for hard floors.
products.subtitle: A low-pile play rug printed as a shoreline map — tide pools, a lighthouse, and a reef to explore.

products.title: ACME Makers 300-Piece Meadow Puzzle
products.description: An original meadow-at-sunrise illustration cut into 300 crisp-edged pieces — big enough to satisfy, small enough to finish in a weekend of table time. The finished 18 x 24 print is frame-worthy, and the lid doubles as a reference stand while you work.
products.subtitle: An original meadow scene in 300 satisfying pieces — an afternoon at the table with a frame-worthy finish.

products.title: ACME Playroom Storybook Bear (14 in)
products.description: A softly weighted 14-inch bear with embroidered eyes and nose — nothing to chew off — and seams that survive being dragged everywhere. Machine washable on gentle, and the fur comes out of the dryer bag as soft as day one.
products.subtitle: A softly weighted bear with embroidered eyes — no buttons, no batteries, endlessly loved.

products.title: ACME Kids Toy Storage Bins (Set of 3)
products.description: Cleanup turns into a beach walk: each bin wears its own icon (shells, fish, driftwood) so putting toys away is the treasure sort. Reinforced rims keep them open; they fold flat when not needed.
products.subtitle: Three collapsible fabric bins with beachcombing labels, sized for figures, blocks, and books.

products.title: ACME Kids Rocket Table Lamp
products.description: A small desk-or-shelf lamp whose shade throws a soft rocket-and-moon profile on the wall. Three brightness levels — reading, wind-down, and barely-there.
products.subtitle: A warm three-level lamp with a rocket silhouette shade for the reading corner.

products.title: ACME Playroom Solar System Poster Set (4 pc)
products.description: A four-poster set that turns walls into reference material: a planet size-comparison chart, a solar-system distance map, a moon-phase calendar, and a rocket anatomy print. Matte stock reads clean under a night light.
products.subtitle: Four matte posters mapping the planets, moon phases, distances, and a launch timeline — decor that answers questions.

products.title: ACME Kids Deep Sea Blackout Curtains (2 panels)
products.description: Deep Sea panels block about 85% of light behind a quiet tone-on-tone wave pattern — plain navy from across the room, rolling surf up close. Standard rod pocket.
products.subtitle: Two blackout panels with a subtle tone-on-tone wave weave — dark enough for early bedtimes.

products.title: ACME Sleep Queen Platform Bed Frame
products.description: The ACME Sleep platform frame pairs a softly cushioned headboard with a solid slat base, so the mattress goes straight on. Steel core rails are wrapped to stay silent; under-bed clearance fits storage bins.
products.subtitle: A queen platform frame with a cushioned linen-look headboard — no box spring, no squeaks.

products.title: ACME Sleep Hybrid Mattress
products.description: The mattress layers pocketed coils under cooling foam for a medium-firm feel that suits back and side sleepers. Arrives compressed, fully expands in 48 hours, and carries a 100-night home trial. Four sizes; the price steps up with each.
products.subtitle: A medium-firm hybrid that ships compressed and settles in two days — 100-night trial.

products.title: ACME Sleep Washed-Cotton Duvet Set, Queen
products.description: Garment-washed cotton with a lived-in softness from day one. Hidden button closure and corner ties keep the insert in place.
products.subtitle: A washed-cotton duvet cover and two shams that look better slightly rumpled.

products.title: ACME Beauty Eye Palette
products.description: The Everyday palette skips the novelty shades: twelve neutrals that blend with fingers in a hurry and layer up for evenings. Vegan formulas, low fallout.
products.subtitle: Twelve wearable neutrals — eight mattes, four shimmers — built for five-minute mornings.

products.title: ACME Beauty Tinted Moisturizer SPF 30
products.description: It evens tone without masking it, layers SPF 30 under everything, and wears for a workday without caking. Six shades, lightest to deepest.
products.subtitle: Sheer, breathable coverage with SPF 30 — skincare that behaves like makeup.

products.title: ACME Beauty Long-Wear Mascara
products.description: It wraps each lash in flexible tubes that don't flake or smudge through a full day, then slide off with warm water and light pressure. No remover needed.
products.subtitle: A tubing mascara that survives the day and removes with warm water — no raccoon eyes either way.

products.title: ACME Pantry Atlantic Salmon Fillets (2 lb, frozen)
products.description: Individually sealed fillets that go from freezer to pan-ready in a bowl of cold water. Skin-on for crispy-skin searing or easy grilling.
products.subtitle: Four vacuum-sealed salmon fillets — a weeknight dinner that defrosts in twenty minutes.

products.title: ACME Pantry Lemon-Herb Marinade & Glaze
products.description: Lemon, garlic, and soft herbs in a marinade that works in fifteen minutes and reduces into a pan glaze. One bottle covers two family dinners.
products.subtitle: A bright lemon-herb marinade that doubles as a finishing glaze for fish or chicken.

products.title: ACME Pantry Weeknight Stir-Fry Dinner Kit
products.description: The Stir-Fry Dinner Kit bundles quick-cook wok noodles, a ginger-garlic sauce that's savory rather than spicy, and a sesame crunch topping. Bring your own protein and vegetables; one pan does the rest.
products.subtitle: Wok noodles, a ginger-garlic sauce, and a crispy topping — add a protein and a bag of frozen veg, done.

products.title: ACME Pantry 90% Lean Ground Beef (1.5 lb)
products.description: A 90/10 blend that browns without a grease slick. Vacuum packing keeps it fresh longer in the fridge or drops straight into the freezer.
products.subtitle: Lean vacuum-packed ground beef in a one-dinner portion — brown it for pasta, chili, or burgers.

products.title: ACME Pantry Fresh Pasta Duo — Rigatoni & Fettuccine
products.description: Fresh egg pasta with real bite: rigatoni for chunky sauces, fettuccine for cream or butter-sage. Four minutes in boiling water.
products.subtitle: Two nests of fresh pasta that cook in four minutes — dinner's four-minute head start.

products.title: ACME Pantry Slow-Simmered Tomato-Basil Sauce
products.description: Crushed tomatoes, basil, olive oil, garlic — simmered down so it tastes like an afternoon you didn't have to spend. One jar coats a pound of pasta.
products.subtitle: A slow-simmered tomato-basil sauce with eight ingredients and no added sugar.

products.title: ACME Pantry Garlic Brioche Dinner Rolls (8 pc)
products.description: Par-baked brioche rolls brushed with garlic butter. Five minutes at 350°F finishes them golden.
products.subtitle: Eight buttery garlic brioche rolls — five minutes in the oven and the table smells like effort.

products.title: ACME Pantry Rainbow Veggie Roasting Mix (2 lb)
products.description: Carrots, broccoli, sweet peppers, and red onion, cut to roast evenly together. Toss with oil, one pan, 25 minutes — a side that goes with nearly any main.
products.subtitle: Pre-cut rainbow vegetables that roast on one sheet pan in 25 minutes.

products.title: ACME Pantry Caesar Salad Kit (family size)
products.description: Crisp romaine with a garlicky (not gloppy) dressing, sourdough croutons, and shaved parmesan. Tossed in the bag if you're feeling efficient.
products.subtitle: A family-size Caesar kit — romaine, dressing, croutons, and real shaved parmesan.

products.title: ACME Pantry Weekend Brownie Skillet Kit
products.description: Everything for a shareable skillet brownie: rich cocoa mix, dark chocolate chunks, and a parchment liner sized for a 10-inch skillet. Add butter and one egg.
products.subtitle: A skillet brownie kit with proper chocolate chunks — dessert that earns the oven preheat.
